name: Chat with the restored JARVIS AI core
description: Verifies the primary JARVIS chat workflow reaches the backend AI core and renders a response.
expected: JARVIS returns a non-empty assistant response instead of the temporary AI-core-unavailable message.

name: Connect and inspect the YouTube authorization center
description: Verifies JARVIS exposes an honest YouTube connection state and does not pretend an account is connected when OAuth credentials are missing.
steps: Inspect the connection status and setup message
expected: The YouTube Connection Center is visible and reports either the real connected channel or that Google OAuth setup is required; it never claims a channel is connected without confirmed authorization.

name: Generate and display an image in JARVIS Image Lab
description: Verifies Image Lab sends an image prompt to the backend image generator and renders the returned image instead of exposing raw JSON.
steps: Enter the prompt "A futuristic aircraft above a neon city at night"
expected: A generated image is rendered inside Image Lab; the interface shows the visual result rather than only JSON or a text response.

name: Run the NEXORA complete simulated trading cycle
description: Verifies one button completes the entire NEXORA paper-trading lifecycle and renders a durable result summary.
steps: Confirm the Empire Command panel is visible
Inspect the entry, exit, P&L, outcome, and five cycle steps
expected: A complete simulated cycle is recorded with entry and exit prices, net P&L, outcome, lifecycle steps, and the updated Prime trade count; the panel states that it is simulation only.

name: Open and run the isolated 10-bot ordinary worker fleet
description: Verifies the worker fleet opens independently from NEXORA PRIME and records a simulated cycle for ten ordinary bots.
steps: Confirm the Empire Command panel is visible
expected: The isolated fleet panel opens, shows ten named BOT records with individual balances and trade statistics, and after one cycle shows updated trades and fleet P&L while stating that the engine is simulation only.

name: Open JARVIS Capability Center and inspect the 18-office registry
description: Verifies JARVIS exposes a user-visible capability map with all 18 offices and honest readiness states.
steps: Inspect the capability summary and office registry
expected: Capability Center is visible, reports 18 offices, and distinguishes ready, authorization-required, planned, and demo-only capabilities.

name: Use Forest Video Studio planning without falsely claiming final video generation
description: Verifies the existing Forest Studio planning workflow remains available and distinguishes generated visual assets from final video-provider output.
expected: A structured video plan can be displayed when the connected service responds, and the UI does not label generated stills as final photoreal video.

name: Filter the Capability Center to attention items on mobile
description: Verifies the Capability Center remains usable on mobile and can isolate capabilities that need attention.
expected: The mobile panel remains readable and shows only capabilities whose state is not READY.
